services.name: api-gateway
services.description: Edge proxy routing all external HTTP traffic to internal services. Handles TLS termination, rate limiting, auth verification, and circuit breaking.

services.name: user-service
services.description: Manages user accounts, profiles, and preferences. Provides internal lookup API used by auth-service and order-service.

services.name: auth-service
services.description: Issues and validates JWT session tokens. Handles OAuth provider integrations (Google, GitHub). Called on every authenticated request via api-gateway.

services.name: payment-service
services.description: Processes charges, refunds, and payment method management via Stripe. PCI-scoped service — all changes require security review.

services.name: order-service
services.description: Manages the full order lifecycle: creation, fulfillment, cancellation, and reconciliation. Coordinates between payment-service and notification-service.

services.name: notification-service
services.description: Sends transactional emails, push notifications, and WebSocket real-time updates. Stateless delivery — retries handled by queue.

services.name: analytics-pipeline
services.description: Reads order and payment data for business intelligence reporting. Non-critical path — user-facing flows do not depend on this service.

services.name: cdn-proxy
services.description: Cloudflare-backed CDN proxy for static assets and cacheable API responses. Sits in front of api-gateway for GET requests.
